item.spearcore.spear.desc: Charge and stab. Faster movement increases damage.
enchantment.spearcore.lunge.description: Push the attacker forward during a stabbing attack.
tetra.module.spear/head.name: Spearhead
tetra.module.spear/head.description: The spearhead turns a shaft into a spear; most of the damage comes from it.
tetra.module.spear/handle.name: Long shaft
tetra.module.spear/handle.description: A longer shaft: more reach, and the primary source of integrity.
tetra.module.spear/binding.name: Binding
tetra.module.spear/binding.description: Binds the head to the shaft; fibre and leather keep the joint firm.
tetra.module.spear/butt.name: Butt cap
tetra.module.spear/butt.description: Weight at the butt end: slightly increases attack damage, balances the spear and steadies the swing.
tetra/schematic/spear/head.name: Spearhead
tetra/schematic/spear/head.description: Replace the current spearhead with one made from the given material, or reforge it.
tetra/schematic/spear/handle.name: Shaft
tetra/schematic/spear/handle.description: Replace the current shaft with one made from the given material, or reforge it.
tetra/schematic/spear/binding.name: Binding
tetra/schematic/spear/binding.descriptio: Bind the spearhead to the shaft with fibre or leather.
tetra/schematic/spear/butt.name: Butt cap
tetra/schematic/spear/butt.description: Add or replace the weight at the butt end.
tetra.module.spear/socket.name: Inlay
tetra.module.spear/socket.description: A fitting at the joint between head and shaft. Any tetra:socket material can be set in; its attributes and effects carry over to the spear.
tetra/schematic/spear/socket.name: Inlay
tetra/schematic/spear/socket.description: Set a socket material into the joint between head and shaft; not limited to gems, and different materials grant different attributes and effects.
tetra.module.spear/shuo_head.name: Shuo head
tetra.module.spear/shuo_head.description: A shuo head: longer and heavier; sweeping blows hit harder and reach further, but slower.
tetra.module.spear/composite_shaft.name: Composite shaft
tetra.module.spear/composite_shaft.descr: A wooden-core composite shaft: the rough blank is weak, and must be reinforced in place with bamboo and vines; high integrity, and eventually longer than a plain shaft.
tetra.module.spear/three_point_blade.des: A three-point, double-edged blade: damage, speed, durability and reach all above a plain spearhead.
tetra/schematic/spear/shuo_head.name: Shuo head
tetra/schematic/spear/shuo_head.descript: Forge a heavier shuo head: more damage and reach, slower handling.
tetra/schematic/spear/composite_shaft.de: Replace the shaft with a laminated bamboo shaft: tougher and longer, but a bit slower to swing.
Forge a three-point, double-edged head: stronger than a plain spearhead in every way.
tetra.unlock.tetra.spear/shuo_head.descr: Requires a §lShuo head scroll§r placed nearby
tetra.unlock.tetra.spear/composite_shaft: Requires a §lComposite shaft scroll§r placed nearby
tetra.unlock.tetra.spear/three_point_bla: Requires the §lThree-point blade scroll§r to be placed on the workbench (intricate schematic)
item.tetra.scroll.spear/shuo_head.name: Shuo head
Laminate planks into a rough composite shaft.
Wrap bamboo strips around the shaft.
tetra/schematic/spear/composite_shaft_fi: With stability honed to level V, the composite shaft is completed.
tetra/schematic/spear/head/hone_sharp.de: After any head hone line reaches V, hone the edge further for extra charged damage.
tetra.improvement.spear_hone/stable.name: Hone: Stability
tetra.improvement.spear_hone/stable.desc: Each level slightly increases attack speed; at level V the shaft can be finished.
tetra.variant.spear_binding/bolt.descrip: An adjustable bolt clamps the head to the shaft.
tetra/schematic/spear/handle/hone_stable: Hone the composite shaft, slightly increasing attack speed.
Hone the composite shaft, slightly increasing attack speed.
Hone the composite shaft, slightly increasing attack speed.
Hone the composite shaft, slightly increasing attack speed.
Hone the composite shaft, slightly increasing attack speed.
tetra/schematic/spear/head/serrated_1.de: Cut teeth into the spearhead: attacks have a 30%% chance to cause bleed (4 damage over 2 seconds); not effective against undead.
tetra/schematic/spear/head/serrated_2.de: Hone the spearhead serrations, increasing the bleed damage.
tetra/schematic/spear/head/serrated_3.de: Further hone the spearhead serrations, increasing the bleed damage again.
tetra/schematic/spear/head/tempered_1.de: Temper the spearhead, greatly increasing its hardness so part of the damage ignores armor.
tetra/schematic/spear/head/tempered_2.de: Further temper the spearhead, increasing armor penetration.
tetra/schematic/spear/head/tempered_3.de: Further temper the spearhead, increasing armor penetration again.
tetra.module.spear/fuller.name: Reinforcement layer
tetra.module.spear/fuller.description: Adds a reinforcing layer along the spear: more durability and a lower chance to take damage, but heavier and slightly slower.
tetra/schematic/spear/fuller.name: Reinforcement layer
tetra/schematic/spear/fuller.description: Make a reinforcing layer from the given material: durability and integrity up, attack speed slightly down.
Wrap the composite shaft in bamboo strips and vines to improve speed, reach and durability; the third stage completes it.
